decision: Choose results for deeper review without declaring a quality ranking.

decision: Retrieve the exact recommendation, response-rate, and completed-survey values for named hospitals.

decision: Identify hospitals whose recommendation result and response rate warrant follow-up.
data_shape: two quantitative measures plus survey-count context
context_required: completed surveys, missingness, release, and noncausal claim
required_companion: table of the plotted values and survey counts
no_display_trigger: Either quantitative measure is mostly missing or not comparable.

case_title: Find patients hidden by an average length of stay
decision: Decide whether the typical stay conceals a long-stay group that changes the improvement plan.

context_required: sample size, subgroup, censoring, and unit definition
required_companion: summary table with n, median, upper quantile, and subgroup counts
no_display_trigger: Only an aggregate mean is available for a distribution question.

case_title: Monitor an emergency-care measure over reporting periods

data_shape: one consistently defined measure across ordered periods
context_required: reporting period, measure-definition stability, target, and ordinary variation
reference_choice: line or run chart with process context
no_display_trigger: Measure definitions or reporting periods change across the series.

case_title: Show how causes contribute to a mortality total

reference_choice: ordered composition view with companion counts
